families.name: Number Of Digits In A Given Number

entries.text:
Count the digits directly.

A positive integer having value from 10^(d-1) to 10^d-1 contains d digits.

Hence the number of digits is {answer}.

Use the product digit formula.

Hence the number of digits is {answer}.

For an n-digit number:

Smallest n-digit number = 10^(n-1)

Largest n-digit number = 10^n - 1

{nDigitNumberFormulaLatex}
